categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: (1) Functional and nutritional feed additives, including flavor enhancers, acidifiers, amino acids, vitamins, and mineral elements; and (2) Enzyme-hydrolyzed protein feed raw materials derived from plant sources such as soybeans, cottonseed, and corn. The company also produces concentrated feed products as a secondary business line.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include formulation technology, preparation/coating technology, and biological enzyme hydrolysis technology. These enable efficient nutrient absorption and utilization in animal feed. The company utilizes enzymatic hydrolysis of plant proteins to improve digestibility, reduce anti-nutritional factors, and release bioactive peptides. Production employs modern manufacturing processes with digital and intelligent manufacturing systems, particularly at the Suzhou facility.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major feed production companies and animal farming enterprises such as Haidagroup, New Hope, Tongwei, Tiankanng Biology, Hefen, Lihua, Baoen Group, Muyuan, and Zhongliang Jiajia. The company serves multiple animal segments including swine, ruminants, poultry, aquaculture, and pets. End markets span domestic Chinese agriculture and international markets across Asia, Europe, Africa, North America, South America, and Oceania.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai's Jiading District. Domestically, it has established sales networks across more than 20 provinces and municipalities. Internationally, the company has established sales networks in over 40 countries and regions including Vietnam, Russia, Thailand, Myanmar, Philippines, Japan, South Korea, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Egypt, Jordan, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico, and Spain, with particular focus on Belt and Road Initiative countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the animal feed supply chain, positioned between raw material suppliers (agricultural commodities, chemical suppliers) and downstream customers (feed manufacturers and animal farming operations). The company sources raw materials and converts them into specialized feed additives and protein ingredients for use in commercial feed production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus emphasizes 'differentiated concentration' development with product strategy of 'species-specific, comprehensive nutrition.' R&D priorities include: developing new enzyme-hydrolyzed protein products from alternative plant sources (corn, cottonseed, soybeans); expanding functional additives for intestinal health and antibiotic alternatives; advancing coating and controlled-release technologies; and developing species-specific solutions for swine, ruminants, poultry, and aquaculture. The company invests approximately 4.3% of revenue in R&D.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of feed additives and enzyme-hydrolyzed protein products to large feed manufacturers and animal farming enterprises, supplemented by distributor/dealer networks for smaller regional customers. Domestic sales utilize a direct-sales-primary, distribution-secondary model, while international sales primarily employ distribution channels. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance and transfer of product control.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in feed additives with over 27 years of industry experience. It holds membership in the China Feed Industry Association and serves as chairman of the Shanghai Feed and Veterinary Medicine Industry Association. The company competes with both domestic and international feed additive manufacturers. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, established customer relationships with major feed producers, and growing international market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized publicly traded enterprise (listed on Shenzhen Stock Exchange, code 301156) with 2024 revenue of approximately 490 million yuan, down 2.87% from 504 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 49.6 million yuan in 2024 versus 63.0 million yuan in 2023. Total assets were 790 million yuan at year-end 2024. The company has demonstrated stable profitability with operating cash flow of 67.2 million yuan in 2024, though recent growth has moderated.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive 'full-lifecycle nutrition' solutions addressing animal needs across growth stages; (2) proprietary enzyme hydrolysis technology enabling superior protein digestibility and bioactive peptide release; (3) controlled-release coating technologies for precise nutrient delivery; (4) extensive product portfolio spanning functional, nutritional, and protein ingredients; (5) strong technical service and customer support ('dual-enhancement service'); and (6) commitment to sustainable, antibiotic-free alternatives supporting modern animal agriculture requirements.
